content.title: Woodside Energy expects demand for LNG to grow 50% over next decade
content.summary: HOUSTON -Woodside Energy CEO Meg O'Neill expects demand for LNG to grow 50% over the next decade. O'Neill spoke on Monday at a groundbreaking ceremony for its Louisiana LNG export facility in Calcasieu Parish, Louisiana.

content.summary: Australia has granted final approval for Woodside’s North West Shelf LNG Project Extension, allowing operations until 2070 under strict environmental conditions.

content.title: Woodside Energy Expands US Presence
